"Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors."

- The spoken text is byte-exact to the brief: "Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors."

**Assumptions I made:** default English voice (the machine's built-in SAPI/Sys.Speech voice), normal pace and pitch, no background music or intro jingle — the brief only asked for the sentence as spoken audio.
